newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends down as greenback rebounds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends down as greenback rebounds.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished lower against its U.S. counterpart on Thursday due to the U.S. dollar's overseas rebound and persisent U.S. dollar buying to meet quarter-end commercial demand, dealers said.
The local unit finished at T$27.880 against Wednesday's T$27.868 close. Turnover through dealers was an active US$182.5 million.
Dealers said they saw U.S. dollar demand from the military in recent sessions. "It seems the military has been buying the U.S. dollar to meet their arms payments," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Quarter-end commercial demand for the U.S. dollar will continue to weaken the Taiwan dollar, dealers said.
A T$27.87-89 range was seen for Friday.
